name: Supply Lab to the Norn canon

correspondences.justification: A SKU is a catalog good kind; canon resource types also cover services.
Non-adjustment stock movements must carry a strictly positive quantity.

residuals.note: The canon ontology pack has no physical warehouse or storage-site class yet.
The canon ontology pack has no semi-additive stock-position snapshot term yet (executable `canon.Holding` lives in `canon/records.ts`).
The canon ontology pack has no `on_hand` / `available` / `reserved` quantity-basis partition term yet.
Supply Lab `StockMovement` admits signed and zero-quantity `adjustment` rows that need not change who holds a resource, so it is not strictly subsumed by canon `norn.core.event`.
Signed movement/adjustment quantity on `StockMovement`; not strictly subsumed by `norn.core.resource.quantity` because zero-quantity adjustments are admitted.

Supply Lab `PurchaseOrder` covers unsubmitted `draft` orders (which may be cancelled before any promise is made) and headers submitted with zero lines, so it is not strictly subsumed by canon `norn.core.commitment` / `core.Commitment`.
Canon `norn.commerce.order.party` models sales customers; purchase-commitment counterparty is not yet in the canon pack.

Supply Lab `OrderLine` is created on `draft` purchase orders prior to submission, so it covers proposed lines before a promise is established and is not strictly subsumed by canon `norn.core.commitment`.

Supply Lab `ReceiptEvidence` permits zero-quantity receipts (`received_qty >= 0 && damaged_qty >= 0`), whereas canon `core.EconomicEvent` / `norn.core.event.transfer` requires strictly positive `quantity > 0`.
Non-negative received quantity on `ShipmentReceipt`; not strictly subsumed by `norn.core.resource.quantity` because zero-quantity receipts are admitted.
Optional order-line reference on `ShipmentReceipt`; not strictly subsumed by `norn.core.event.fulfils` because `ShipmentReceipt` admits zero-quantity receipt records.
The canon ontology pack has no quality-inspection evidence class yet.
The canon ontology pack has no weekly demand-observation analytical input class.
The canon ontology pack has no contract-checked ML demand-forecast prediction class.
Checks order-line-to-purchase-order currency equality before any arithmetic combination, whereas canon `norn.finance.guard.currency.mismatch` is scoped to combining amounts in different currencies.
The canon ontology pack has a currency-mismatch guard but no unit-of-measure mismatch guard term yet.
Raw WMS scan feed evidence staging record kept separate from governed stock positions.
Raw ERP supplier-feed line evidence kept separate from governed shipment receipts.
